question.tr: Servis tarifiyle kurulan %90 aralık, eğitimden sonraki taramanın yeni ilanlarında ne kadar kapsıyor; banda göre hata payı orada da yardım ediyor mu?
question.en: How much does the 90% interval built by the served recipe cover on the new listings of a later snapshot, and does a per-band margin still help there?

data_slice: load_clean(all_snapshots=True). The forward setups of 09_backtest: every single-arm row (train on one snapshot, test on each later one) and every cumulative row whose training differs from the single arm's (9 setups). Test = the listings of the test snapshot whose ad_id never occurs in training.
split: temporal: the headline setup of 09_backtest (cv.fold_matrices + cv.LGB_PARAMS, trees from an inner early-stopping 5-fold CV on the training set); nothing from the test snapshot sets the model, q or the band edges.
target: The served recipe applied forward: q = the finite-sample 90% quantile (ceil((n+1)·0.9)-th smallest) of the training set's own 5-fold OOF errors |log1p(price) − log1p(clip(OOF prediction))|; band edges = quartiles of the training OOF predictions. Two arms: one q, and one q per predicted-price band (Mondrian). Measured on the test listings of each setup: coverage overall, per band, and on the listings whose (model, year) never occurs in training. Known before registration: an independent audit on 2026-09-28 measured 4 of these setups ad hoc (per-band coverage 87.0–90.2% on the 06-27 snapshot; one-q overall 87.4–89.9%), so these hypotheses are not blind; the plan fixes the definitions and the setups before this code runs.

statement.tr: İleri kullanımda banda göre hata payı, tahmini en ucuz bantta tek hata payından daha yüksek kapsama verir, her kurulumda.
statement.en: Used forward, the per-band margin covers more than the single margin in the cheapest predicted band, in every setup.

hypotheses.accept_if: coverage_band > coverage_global in band Q1 in all 9 setups
hypotheses.reject_if: coverage_band <= coverage_global in band Q1 in any setup

statement.tr: İleri kullanımda banda göre hata payı her bantta ve her kurulumda en az %88 kapsar.
statement.en: Used forward, the per-band margin covers at least 88% in every band of every setup.

hypotheses.accept_if: min over the 9 setups and 4 bands of coverage_band >= 88 (percent)
hypotheses.reject_if: coverage_band < 88 in any band of any setup

out_of_scope: Changing the served interval (encoders.pkl CONFORMAL_Q) or the live API
Recalibrating q on the test snapshot or adapting it over time (online conformal)
Bands on anything but the predicted price
